description: http://angelaandbrooks.com currently returns 200 over plain HTTP (no redirect) with no HSTS, so browsers show not secure. Add an app-level redirect (308) from http->https in middleware (use x-forwarded-proto) and a Strict-Transport-Security header on responses.
title: Force HTTPS and add HSTS (fix the "not secure" warning)
acceptance_criteria: The Strict-Transport-Security header is present on https responses
The gate and /admin still work after the change
Verified on the live apex showing secure
